Taylor H.: Quick report from onboarding: Go generator sample hangs when canceling the parent ctx mid-stream. Repro: start generator, read one token, cancel ctx. Next() can block until server finishes.

Taylor H.: Minimal repro snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
_, _ = iter.Next()
cancel()
// Next() sometimes blocks
```

Rae M.: Oof. Which transport in the sample?

Taylor H.: net/http. Root cause seems to be auth refresh + transport retry reopening the stream; the old reader goroutine stays blocked on Read().

Samir V.: Parity gap vs node/python. Proposal: add io.Closer to Generator iterator so callers can `defer iter.Close()`; Close cancels internal request context and makes Next() return context.Canceled quickly. Also add per-call meta `NoRetryOnStream:true` so transport won't auto-retry streaming calls.

Rae M.: Short-term: update sample to show `defer iter.Close()` and read loop that selects on ctx.Done() then calls iter.Close(). Add Quickstart blurb. Long-term: consider NextWithCtx(ctx) and a buffer/backpressure option like `BufferTokens`.

Taylor H.: I'll open a small sample-app PR with docs. Samir, can you own the SDK change and a unit test that asserts Next() returns within ~100ms after Close()? Add a CI goroutine-leak regression that snapshots runtime.NumGoroutine() before/after.

Samir V.: Yep. Will implement Close(), wire request cancel, add NoRetryOnStream default for streaming endpoints, and include tests for the 401 refresh race.

bot-ops: Created issue #2410: "go-sdk: generator stream cancel semantics and transport retry race".

Taylor H.: Thanks all. Once patches land, update Quickstart and release notes to reduce onboarding churn.

Rae M.: Also capture follow-ups: NextWithCtx API, buffer/backpressure knobs, and evaluate making NoRetryOnStream the default long-term.

Taylor H.: Filing follow-ups after immediate fixes.
